mapper.select: SELECT distinct s8.MATCH_STATUS matchStatus, ROUND(s6.MARCH_QTY / s1.SHARE_AMT,4) matchProgress, s1.APPLY_TRADE_ID applyTradeId, s1.SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId, s2.SEC_ACCT_NAME secAcctName, s7.finprod_market_id finprodMarketId, s7.finprod_abbr finprodAbbr, s1.seat_number seatNumber, s5.MATCH_CLASS matchType, s1.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, s1.TRADE_PLAT tradePlat, s1.finprod_type2 finprodType2, s1.ps ps, s1.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, CASE WHEN s1.SEC_TYPE = #{SEC_TYPE_09} THEN s1.UNIT_CPRICE ELSE s1.UNIT_FPRICE END unitFprice, ifnull(S6.MARCH_QTY,0) shareAmt, ifnull(S6.MARCH_AMT,0) tradeAmt, s9.acct_no acctNo, s9.acct_name acctName FROM SETTLE_TRANS_DATA_TOTAL s1 LEFT JOIN SETTLE_TRANS_DATA_TOTAL_MATCH s5 ON s1.SEQ_ID = s5.SEQ_NO LEFT JOIN SETTLE_TRANS_DATA_TOTAL_STATUS s8 ON s1.SEQ_ID = s8.SEQ_NO LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO s2 ON s2.SEC_ACCT_ID=s1.SEC_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO s9 ON s1.ACCT_NO = s9.ACCT_NO INNER JOIN SETTLE_TRANS_DATA_TOTAL_STATUS s4 ON s4.SEQ_NO=s1.SEQ_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SEQ_NO, ifnull(SUM(MARCH_QTY),0) MARCH_QTY, ifnull(SUM(MARCH_AMT),0) MARCH_AMT FROM SETTLE_TRANS_DATA_TOTAL_MATCH GROUP BY SEQ_NO ) S6 ON S6.SEQ_NO = S1.SEQ_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT S7 ON S1.FINPROD_ID = S7.FINPROD_ID WHERE s1.SEQ_ID=#{seqNo}

SELECT s1.ENTRUNST_TRADE_ID entrustId, #{TRADE_TYPE_02} tradeType, e1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, p1.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, s3.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, CASE WHEN s3.SEC_TYPE=#{SEC_TYPE_09} THEN NULL ELSE f1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID END finprodMarketId, CASE WHEN s3.SEC_TYPE=#{SEC_TYPE_09} THEN NULL ELSE f1.FINPROD_ID END finprodId, e1.ENTRUST_DATE entrustDate, e1.trade_market tradeMarket, e1.trade_plat tradePlat, e1.PS ps, e1.PRICE price, CASE WHEN s3.SEC_TYPE=#{SEC_TYPE_09} THEN ifnull(S4.MARCH_AMT_EN,0) ELSE ifnull(S4.MARCH_QTY_EN,0) END entrustNum, ifnull(S4.MARCH_AMT_EN,0) entrustAmt, s5.sec_acct_name secAcctName, s6.acct_name acctName FROM SETTLE_TRANS_DATA_TOTAL_MATCH s1 INNER JOIN SETTLE_TRANS_DATA_TOTAL_STATUS s2 ON s2.SEQ_NO=s1.SEQ_NO AND s2.MATCH_STATUS IN (#{TRD_MATCH_STATUS_1},#{TRD_MATCH_STATUS_2}) INNER JOIN SETTLE_TRANS_DATA_TOTAL s3 ON s3.SEQ_ID=s1.SEQ_NO LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST e1 ON e1.ENTRUST_ID=s1.ENTRUNST_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT f1 ON f1.FINPROD_ID=s3.FINPROD_ID LEFT join PTL_PORTFOLIO p1 on p1.PORTFOLIO_ID=e1.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SEQ_NO, ENTRUNST_TRADE_ID, ifnull(SUM(MARCH_QTY_EN),0) MARCH_QTY_EN, ifnull(SUM(MARCH_AMT_EN),0) MARCH_AMT_EN FROM SETTLE_TRANS_DATA_TOTAL_MATCH GROUP BY SEQ_NO,ENTRUNST_TRADE_ID ) S4 ON S4.SEQ_NO = S1.SEQ_NO AND S4.ENTRUNST_TRADE_ID = E1.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO s5 ON s3.SEC_ACCT_ID=s5.SEC_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO s6 ON s3.ACCT_NO = s6.ACCT_NO WHERE s1.seq_no=#{seqNo}
